title: Rigidity: a horizontally invariant, vertically monotone set with two-sided positive volume near 0 is the half-space {⟨y, e⟩ > 0}
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, G ⊆ ℝ^N Lebesgue null-measurable and e ∈ ℝ^N with |e| = 1. Assume (H) ∫_G Dζ(y)v dy = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported ζ : ℝ^N → ℝ and every v ∈ ℝ^N with ⟨v, e⟩ = 0; (M) ∫_G Dζ(y)e dy ≤ 0 for every C¹ compactly supported ζ : ℝ^N → ℝ with ζ ≥ 0; (P) L^N(G ∩ B_R(0)) > 0 and L^N(B_R(0) ∖ G) > 0 for every R > 0. Then L^N(G Δ {y : ⟨y, e⟩ > 0}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : Set (Rn N)) (e : Rn N), NullMeasurableSet G volume → ‖e‖ = 1 → (∀ (ζ : Rn N → ℝ) (v : Rn N), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → inner ℝ v e = 0 → ∫ y in G, fderiv ℝ ζ y v = 0) → (∀ ζ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → ∫ y in G, fderiv ℝ ζ y e ≤ 0) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < volume (G ∩ Metric.ball 0 R) ∧ 0 < volume (Metric.ball 0 R \ G)) → volume (symmDiff G {y | 0 < inner ℝ y e}) = 0
